description: This file contains utility functions for processing transaction data, including calculations for outflow, inflow, flagged transactions, average spend, top spend categories, largest transactions, and daily spending series. It also exports a function to build a dashboard snapshot with these metrics.

methods.name: isFiniteNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite number.

methods.name: topSpendCategories
methods.description: Returns top N categories by spend.

methods.name: largestSpendingTransactions
methods.description: Returns top N transactions by absolute amount spent.

methods.name: spendingByDaySeries
methods.description: Builds a time series of daily outflow totals.

methods.name: buildDashboardSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of dashboard metrics including KPIs, series, and tables.
